name: Helprspace Contact Bubble
author: khalidpro

sections.description:
Helprspace Contact Bubble adds a clean, fast floating contact button to your website. Visitors tap it, pick their favourite app – WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, Instagram and more – and start a conversation with you in one tap.

A small, focused plugin: its own CSS and JavaScript are loaded the standard WordPress way (no third-party libraries, no external requests, no tracking).

16 channels included

  • WhatsApp
  • Telegram
  • Facebook Messenger
  • Instagram
  • Discord
  • Slack
  • Microsoft Teams
  • Skype
  • Viber
  • WeChat
  • LINE
  • Signal
  • Email
  • Phone call
  • SMS
  • Custom link – point a button at any URL: booking page, contact form, help desk

Features

  • Up to 5 channels, each with its own colour and custom label
  • Greeting message at the top of the menu
  • Bottom-right or bottom-left position
  • Main button colour picker
  • Device targeting – show any channel on desktop only, mobile only, or both
  • Test mode – preview the widget on a single private page before going live
  • Works with any theme and page builder (Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Bricks and more)
  • Compatible with all caching plugins (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache)
  • Fully responsive and keyboard accessible
  • Clean uninstall – deletes its own settings, leaves nothing behind

Privacy

This plugin sets no cookies, loads nothing from third-party servers and collects no visitor data. When a visitor clicks a channel button, they are taken to that channel using its official public link format (for example wa.me for WhatsApp or t.me for Telegram) – exactly like clicking a normal link.

Helprspace Contact Bubble Pro

Need more? Pro turns the button into a mini support desk:

  • FAQ layer – answer common questions before the chat starts
  • Smart Answers – visitors type a question, the widget finds the answer from your knowledge base. Works offline, no AI keys, no monthly costs
  • Business hours with offline message
  • Show or hide the widget on specific pages
  • Pre-filled messages for WhatsApp, SMS and Email
  • Unlimited channels
  • Click analytics, team agents and proactive triggers

Learn more about Pro
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New and search for “Helprspace Contact Bubble”.
  2. Install and activate the plugin.
  3. Open the new Chat Bubble menu in your admin sidebar.
  4. Click + Add channel, pick a channel, enter your contact detail and save.
  5. Visit your site – the chat button is live.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow my site down?

No. It only loads its own small CSS and JS file, and only on pages where the widget actually appears – no external scripts, no jQuery dependency on the front end.

Do I need a WhatsApp Business account or any API key?

No. Every channel uses the official public link format of each app (wa.me, t.me, m.me and so on). No accounts, keys or monthly fees.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. Assets are loaded the standard WordPress way, so cached pages always include the widget correctly.

Can I show different channels on mobile and desktop?

Yes. Each channel has Desktop and Mobile tick boxes.

How do I test the widget before showing it to visitors?

Enter a page ID in the Test mode field. The widget then appears only on that page until you clear the field.

Is it GDPR compliant?

The plugin sets no cookies, collects no data and connects to no third-party servers. Clicking a channel simply opens that channel’s standard link.

1.3.0

  • Renamed to Helprspace Contact Bubble for a distinct, non-generic identity.

1.2.0

  • Renamed to Helprspace Contact Bubble.
  • Assets are now registered and loaded through wp_enqueue_style() / wp_enqueue_script() instead of printed inline.
  • All function/class/constant/option/hook names now use a unique plugin-specific prefix.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: 16 channel types, per-channel colours, labels and device targeting, greeting message, position and colour settings, test mode.
